description: This Java class provides utility methods for managing and checking the status of keyboard input methods and related UI animations within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It includes functions to determine if the current keyboard is set as default, enabled, and if a language pack for the current locale is available, as well as methods for animating views.

classes.name: SetupSupport
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to check keyboard input method status, locale-specific language pack availability, and to perform view animations within the setup UI of the keyboard app.

methods.name: isThisKeyboardSetAsDefaultIME
methods.description: Checks if the current keyboard is set as the default input method editor (IME) on the device.

methods.name: isThisKeyboardSetAsDefaultIMEPrior34
methods.description: Helper method to determine if the default IME matches the app's package name for Android versions prior to API 34.

methods.name: isThisKeyboardEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the keyboard app is enabled in the device's input method settings.

methods.name: hasLanguagePackForCurrentLocale
methods.description: Determines if there is a language pack available for the current device locale.

methods.name: popupViewAnimationWithIds
methods.description: Animates multiple views identified by their resource IDs with a popup animation sequence.

methods.name: popupViewAnimation
methods.description: Performs a popup animation on the provided views with staggered start offsets.
